hooks.name: Fast tests on save
hooks.description: After a Python file under coroner/ or tests/ is saved, runs pytest -x on the test file that matches it (tests/test_<name>.py), or on a fixed subset of 5 fast test files when no test file matches. Slow tests are not run. Measured: 1.1 s for coroner/verdict.py, 6.0 s for tests/test_compare.py, 6.8 s for the fixed subset. Limit: the script stops pytest after 25 s and says so, which is neither a pass nor a fail; saving coroner/hooks.py or tests/test_hooks.py hits that limit (that test file alone takes about 31 s).
